spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence describes a permanent habit?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] My father reads the newspaper every morning with his coffee.
B. [WRONG] My father is reading a thriller at the moment.
C. [WRONG] My father read the newspaper every day when he was younger.
D. [WRONG] My father is reading the paper right now.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: My father is reading a thriller at the moment., My father read the newspaper every day when he was younger., My father is reading the paper right now.
